notes: Object connectivity: every networked object (Access Point, IP Telephone, Printer, TV, IP Camera, Access Controller, UPS) has the same Network section: Interface, Port speed and Connected to
Access Points: 1G, 2.5G, 5G or 10G; every object defaults to Ethernet RJ45 at Gigabit (1G)
Connected to names the switch port and warns about speed or copper / fiber mismatches
Printer, TV and IP Camera: Wired or Wireless; the cable fields show only when Wired
Excel adds Interface and Port Speed columns
